roleContext.roleTitle: Supply Chain Data Scientist, Outdoor Power Equipment
roleContext.jobDescription: The company assembles lawn mowers, hedge trimmers and leaf blowers in two plants and sells them through dealers and garden centres. Demand is strongly seasonal and peaks between March and June. The Supply Chain Data Scientist looks after the dealer-level replenishment model, quantifies how weather moves spring sell-through, briefs the monthly S&OP review and keeps the model code under version control with peer review. A qualified panel reads the evidence packet alongside its own interview notes, and every hiring decision rests with that panel. The data science team has three members and reports to the head of supply chain planning; models are written in Python and scheduled through the plants' planning system, and dealer-support staff use the replenishment screen every day.

requirements.text: Develops and maintains a dealer-level replenishment model for seasonal products.
Trains dealer-support staff to read the replenishment recommendations.
Quantifies the effect of weather variables on spring sell-through.
Briefs the monthly S&OP review on demand risks and replenishment changes.
Keeps model code under version control with peer-reviewed merge requests.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Supply Chain Data Scientist, Outdoor Power Equipment

## Experience

- Developed the dealer-level replenishment model for 640 garden-equipment dealers at Corvane Outdoor, setting weekly order-up-to levels from sell-through, supplier lead times and dealer stock reports.
- Added regional temperature and rainfall series to the spring sell-through model and estimated their effect with a hierarchical regression fitted on the 2019 to 2023 seasons.
- Briefed the monthly S&OP review from September 2023 to August 2024 on demand risks and proposed changes to replenishment parameters; the review minutes record each briefing.
- Kept all model code in the team's Git repository and opened merge requests that a second data scientist reviewed before each release to the scheduling job.
- Ran two lunchtime sessions for the dealer-support desk on reading the replenishment screen.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an extract of the S&OP review minutes for March 2024 that lists the candidate as presenter of the demand-risk item, with the slide used: the mower forecast range by region, the weather assumption and a proposed safety-stock change for two dealer clusters.
